entities.summary: Yusif Haydar oglu Mammadaliyev was an Azerbaijani and Soviet chemist. He was a doctor of chemistry, academician of the National Academy of Sciences of the Azerbaijan SSR, and was the president of the National Academy of Sciences of the Azerbaijan SSR.
